2123825657507705284.en_summary: Funny to see @citrini today shorting $TTWO and longing $SONY around GTA 6. This is the exact thesis I laid out in June and made the trade of the year on FinX. One thing to note I think they missed in their report but aligns with bearishness on $TTWO. While critic scores are high, social media comments indicate MAJOR frustration with the game. I still think everyone buys it, but the core GTA audience was abandoned, which could weigh on online engagement when it does drop.
2123825657507705284.zh_summary: 有趣的是看到@citrini今天在GTA 6周圍做空$TTWO並做多$SONY。這正是我在6月提出的論點，並在FinX上做了年度交易。有一件事我認為他們在報告中錯過了，但與對$TTWO的看空一致。雖然評論分數很高，但社交媒體評論顯示對遊戲的重大挫折。我仍然認為每個人都會買它，但核心GTA觀眾被拋棄，這可能在發佈時影響線上參與。

ticker_notes.TTWO: 社交媒體對GTA6挫折，核心觀眾被拋棄可能影響線上參與
